title: Skallestadveien 36, Bygg 3 og 4: fire concept report, version 1 (2025-03-25)
jurisdiction: Norway, Færder kommune (document hosted on the municipal site; client Vestfold Bygg & Eiendom AS). Comparative only, not Alberta.
code_edition: TEK17 and VTEK17, chapter 11 (contents p. 3; section 3 heading p. 3)

facts.text: Report title 'Skallestadveien 36 – Bygg 3 og 4 – Rapport – Brannkonsept, Versjon 1, 25.03.2025'. Client Vestfold Bygg & Eiendom AS; prepared by PiD Solutions AS (Siril Agerup Hektoen); checked by Lars Haugrud.
Summary: fire concept for two new buildings described as 'firemannsboliger' (term as written in the report).

Summary classes: risk class (RKL) 4; fire class (BKL) 1; technical class (TTKL) 1. Independent control of design: NO. Independent control of fire execution: decided by the building application. Deviations from pre-accepted performance: NO.
Section 2.4.1 states that no deviations from pre-accepted solutions in VTEK17 are designed ('Det er ikke prosjektert med fravik fra preaksepterte løsninger gitt i VTEK17').
Responsibility is split between RIB, RIV and RIE under the building-application responsibility rules ('ansvarsrett').

Background documents (Table 1-2) list plans, facades and sections, site plan and perspectives by Re Arkitektur AS, dated 2025-02-12. The output list (Table 1-3) includes 'Branntegning Bygg 3 plan 1 / Bygg 4 kjeller' by PiD Solutions AS.
Says that any change departing from the fire strategy must be submitted to SØK (abbreviation as written), and the fire concept goes to SØK with the fire design.
Refers to standard detail sheet 520.321 'Brannmotstand for etasjeskiller' for floor build-ups.

limitations: Comparative test only (Norway, Færder kommune). Residential, not timber-specific (keyword scan found no timber terms).
